desc: Derive the matching condition for `a*b*c`: choose ordered non-overlapping half-open occurrences of `a`, `b`, and `c`, minimizing final end minus initial start, with empty parts occurring at every boundary.
Implement an `O(n + |p|)` KMP occurrence finder, including explicit all-boundary occurrence lists for empty literal pieces.
Build linear-time successor lookups and greedily evaluate compatible `a -> b -> c` occurrence chains.
Validate implementation on provided examples and edge cases: `**`, leading/trailing stars, adjacent stars, overlapping/repeated literals, and absent pieces.
Write the final Python implementation in `Solution.shortestMatchingSubstring`.
